# Default: force LF line endings for text files
# Prevents Windows CRLF phantom diffs across machines
* text=auto eol=lf

# Explicit text files
*.md          text eol=lf
*.json        text eol=lf
*.ts          text eol=lf
*.tsx         text eol=lf

*.sh          text eol=lf

# Windows scripts keep CRLF
*.bat         text eol=crlf
*.cmd         text eol=crlf
*.ps1         text eol=crlf

*.png         binary
*.jpg         binary
*.jpeg        binary
*.gif         binary
*.ico         binary

  group: verify-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  native-postgres:
    name: Native PostgreSQL worksheet and tenant regression
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:17
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: m63_test_admin
          POSTGRES_DB: m63_integration
          POSTGRES_HOST_AUTH_METHOD: trust
        ports:
          - 55463:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "pg_isready -U m63_test_admin -d m63_integration"
          --health-interval 5s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
        with:
          bun-version: 1.3.12
      - run: bun install --frozen-lockfile
      - name: Initialize and challenge isolated PostgreSQL roles and storage
        run: bun test packages/neuvetra-database/src/hosted.test.ts
        env:
          M63_TEST_DATABASE_URL: postgres://m63_test_admin@127.0.0.1:55463/m63_integration
      - name: Verify staged HTTP and frontend decoding against PostgreSQL
        run: bun test apps/site-api/src/staging/postgres.test.ts apps/site-api/src/workspace/m66-postgres.test.ts apps/site-api/src/workspace/m67-postgres.test.ts apps/site-api/src/workspace/m68-postgres.test.ts apps/site-api/src/workspace/m71-postgres.test.ts
        env:
          M63_API_TEST_DATABASE_URL: postgres://m63_test_admin@127.0.0.1:55463/m63_integration
          M71_API_TEST_DATABASE_URL: postgres://m63_test_admin@127.0.0.1:55463/m63_integration
      - name: Prepare isolated stationary natural-gas native fixture
        run: bun tools/staging/m73-backend-fixture.ts m73_author_ci --ci-baseline=m63_integration
      - name: Verify stationary natural-gas storage, calculation, reports and browser decoder
        run: bun test apps/site-api/src/workspace/m73-postgres.test.ts
        env:
          M73_TEST_DATABASE_URL: postgres://m63_test_admin@127.0.0.1:55463/m73_author_ci
      - name: Prepare isolated mobile-diesel native fixture
        run: bun tools/staging/m74-backend-fixture.ts m74_author_ci --ci-baseline=m63_integration
      - name: Verify mobile-diesel storage, two-evidence calculation, reports and browser decoder
        run: bun test apps/site-api/src/workspace/m74-postgres.test.ts apps/site-api/src/calculation/m74-authority.test.ts
        env:
          M74_TEST_DATABASE_URL: postgres://m63_test_admin@127.0.0.1:55463/m74_author_ci

        run: bun test evaluations/research-qa/m74-independent-accounting-native.test.ts
        env:
          M74_ACCOUNTING_TEMPLATE_DATABASE: m74_author_ci

      - name: Prepare isolated controlled-fleet native fixture
        run: bun tools/staging/m75-backend-fixture.ts m75_author_ci --ci-baseline=m63_integration
      - name: Verify controlled-fleet persistence, reconciliation and access boundaries
        run: bun test apps/site-api/src/workspace/m75-postgres.test.ts
        env:
          M75_TEST_DATABASE_URL: postgres://m63_test_admin@127.0.0.1:55463/m75_author_ci
      - name: Prepare isolated stationary equipment native fixture
        run: bun tools/staging/m76-backend-fixture.ts m76_author_ci --ci-baseline=m63_integration
      - name: Verify stationary equipment persistence, exact calculation and access boundaries
        run: bun test apps/site-api/src/workspace/m76-postgres.test.ts
        env:
          M76_TEST_DATABASE_URL: postgres://m63_test_admin@127.0.0.1:55463/m76_author_ci
      - name: Independently challenge stationary arithmetic and historical proof
        run: bun test evaluations/research-qa/m76-independent-native.test.ts
        env:
          M76_INDEPENDENT_NATIVE: enabled
          M76_QA_TEMPLATE: m76_author_ci
      - name: Independently challenge cross-family fuel evidence and retained capacity
        run: |
          bun test evaluations/research-qa/m76-independent-native-security.test.ts
          bun test evaluations/research-qa/m76-independent-native-capacity.test.ts
          bun test evaluations/research-qa/m76-independent-native-report-capacity.test.ts
        env:
          M76_INDEPENDENT_NATIVE: enabled

def canonical(value):
    return json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"))


def digest(value):

def require(condition):

def keys(value, names):

def exact(value):
    denominator = value.denominator
    places = 0
    while denominator != 1:
        divisor = 2 if denominator % 2 == 0 else 5 if denominator % 5 == 0 else None
        assert divisor is not None
        denominator //= divisor
        places += 1
    integer = value.numerator * 10**places // value.denominator
    if places == 0:
        return str(integer)
    text = str(integer).zfill(places + 1)
    return (text[:-places] + '.' + text[-places:]).rstrip('0').rstrip('.')

param(

 [ValidateSet(55463,55472)][int]$Port=55472
)
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Security
$stage='configuration'
try {
 $target=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath($ArchivePath)
 $hasher=[Security.Cryptography.SHA256]::Create()
 if($Mode -eq 'Seal'){
  $content=[Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes([Console]::In.ReadToEnd())
  if($content.Length -lt 100){throw 'empty bundle'}
  $stage='protect'
  $protected=[Security.Cryptography.ProtectedData]::Protect($content,$null,[Security.Cryptography.DataProtectionScope]::CurrentUser)
  $stage='write_new_archive'
  $stream=[IO.File]::Open($target,[IO.FileMode]::CreateNew,[IO.FileAccess]::Write,[IO.FileShare]::None)
  try{$stream.Write($protected,0,$protected.Length);$stream.Flush($true)}finally{$stream.Dispose()}
  $stage='verify_unprotect'
  $restored=[Security.Cryptography.ProtectedData]::Unprotect([IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($target),$null,[Security.Cryptography.DataProtectionScope]::CurrentUser)
  if([Convert]::ToBase64String($hasher.ComputeHash($content)) -ne [Convert]::ToBase64String($hasher.ComputeHash($restored))){throw 'mismatch'}
  Write-Output '{"status":"m76_bundle_sealed"}'
 }else{
  if($DatabaseName -notmatch '^m76_(ops|qa|security)_[a-z0-9_]+$' -or -not $PgRestorePath -or -not $ReceiptPath -or (Test-Path -LiteralPath $ReceiptPath)){throw 'target refused'}
  $bytes=[IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($target)
  $hash=[BitConverter]::ToString($hasher.ComputeHash($bytes)).Replace('-','').ToLowerInvariant()
  $stage='unprotect'
  $bundle=[Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString([Security.Cryptography.ProtectedData]::Unprotect($bytes,$null,[Security.Cryptography.DataProtectionScope]::CurrentUser))
  $start=New-Object Diagnostics.ProcessStartInfo
  $start.FileName=(Get-Command bun).Source
  $script=Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'm76-restore.ts'
  foreach($arg in @($PgRestorePath,$ReceiptPath)){if($arg.Contains('"') -or $arg.Contains("`n") -or $arg.Contains("`r")){throw 'invalid path'}}
  $start.Arguments='run "'+$script+'" "'+[IO.Path]::GetFullPath($PgRestorePath)+'" '+$DatabaseName+' "'+[IO.Path]::GetFullPath($ReceiptPath)+'" '+$hash+' '+$Port
  $start.UseShellExecute=$false;$start.CreateNoWindow=$true
  $start.RedirectStandardInput=$true;$start.RedirectStandardOutput=$true;$start.RedirectStandardError=$true
  $stage='restore_child'
  $process=[Diagnostics.Process]::Start($start)
  $stdout=$process.StandardOutput.ReadToEndAsync();$stderr=$process.StandardError.ReadToEndAsync()
  $process.StandardInput.Write($bundle);$process.StandardInput.Close();$process.WaitForExit()
  Write-Output $stdout.Result
  if($process.ExitCode -ne 0){throw 'restore failed'}
 }
}catch{Write-Output ('{"status":"m76_bundle_operation_failed","mode":"'+$Mode+'","stage":"'+$stage+'"}');exit 1}
